verses.textZh: 在士师统治期间，国内发生了饥荒。有一个人带着妻子和两个儿子，从犹大的伯利恒前往摩押地去，寄居在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在士师统治期间，国内发生了饥荒。有一个人带着妻子和两个儿子，从犹大的伯利恒前往摩押地去，寄居在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 当士师秉政的时候，国中遭遇饥荒。在犹大的伯利恒，有一个人带着妻子和两个儿子往摩押地去寄居。
verses.textEnNiv: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. So a man from Bethlehem in Judah, together with his wife and two sons, went to live for a while in the country of Moab.
verses.textEnEsv: In the days when the judges ruled there was a famine in the land, and a man of Bethlehem in Judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he and his wife and his two sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehem, Judah, went to dwell in the country of Moab, he and his wife and his two sons.
verses.textEnNlt: In the days when the judges ruled in Israel, a severe famine came upon the land. So a man from Bethlehem in Judah left his home and went to live in the country of Moab, taking his wife and two sons with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the days when the judges governed, that there was a famine in the land. And a man of Bethlehem in Judah went to reside in the land of Moab with his wife and his two sons.
verses.textEn: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. So a man from Bethlehem in Judah, together with his wife and two sons, went to live for a while in the country of Moab.

verses.textZh: 这个人名叫以利米勒，妻子名叫拿俄米，两个儿子叫玛伦和基连，都是犹大伯利恒的以法他人。他们到了摩押地，就在那里住下来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这个人名叫以利米勒，妻子名叫拿俄米，两个儿子叫玛伦和基连，都是犹大伯利恒的以法他人。他们到了摩押地，就在那里住下来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人名叫以利米勒，他的妻名叫拿俄米；他两个儿子，一个名叫玛伦，一个名叫基连，都是犹大伯利恒的以法他人。他们到了摩押地，就住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: The man’s name was Elimelek, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Kilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem, Judah. And they went to Moab and lived there.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of the man was Elimelech and the name of his wife Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem in Judah. They went into the country of Moab and remained there.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of the man was Elimelech, the name of his wife was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion— Ephrathites of Bethlehem, Judah. And they went to the country of Moab and remained there.
verses.textEnNlt: The man’s name was Elimelech, and his wife was Naomi. Their two sons were Mahlon and Kilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem in the land of Judah. And when they reached Moab, they settled there.
verses.textEnNasb: The name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife, Naomi; and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem in Judah. So they entered the land of Moab and remained there.
verses.textEn: The man’s name was Elimelek, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Kilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem, Judah. And they went to Moab and lived there.

verses.textZh: 后来拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒去世了，留下她和两个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒去世了，留下她和两个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒死了，剩下妇人和她两个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Elimelek, Naomi’s husband, died, and she was left with her two sons.
verses.textEnEsv: But Elimelech, the husband of Naomi, died, and she was left with her two sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left, and her two sons.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elimelech died, and Naomi was left with her two sons.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.
verses.textEn: Now Elimelek, Naomi’s husband, died, and she was left with her two sons.

verses.textZh: 他们娶了摩押女子作妻子，一个名叫俄耳巴，一个名叫路得。他们在那里住了约有十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们娶了摩押女子作妻子，一个名叫俄耳巴，一个名叫路得。他们在那里住了约有十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 这两个儿子娶了摩押女子为妻，一个名叫俄珥巴，一个名叫路得，在那里住了约有十年。
verses.textEnNiv: They married Moabite women, one named Orpah and the other Ruth. After they had lived there about ten years,
verses.textEnEsv: These took Moabite wives; the name of the one was Orpah and the name of the other Ruth. They lived there about ten years,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now they took wives of the women of Moab: the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth. And they dwelt there about ten years.
verses.textEnNlt: The two sons married Moabite women. One married a woman named Orpah, and the other a woman named Ruth. But about ten years later,
verses.textEnNasb: And they took for themselves Moabite women as wives; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other, Ruth. And they lived there about ten years.
verses.textEn: They married Moabite women, one named Orpah and the other Ruth. After they had lived there about ten years,

verses.textZh: 后来，玛伦和基连二人也死了，留下拿俄米，既没有了两个儿子，又没有了丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，玛伦和基连二人也死了，留下拿俄米，既没有了两个儿子，又没有了丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛伦和基连二人也死了，剩下拿俄米，没有丈夫，也没有儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: both Mahlon and Kilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and her husband.
verses.textEnEsv: and both Mahlon and Chilion died, so that the woman was left without her two sons and her husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then both Mahlon and Chilion also died; so the woman survived her two sons and her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: both Mahlon and Kilion died. This left Naomi alone, without her two sons or her husband.
verses.textEnNasb: Then both Mahlon and Chilion also died, and the woman was left without her two sons and her husband.
verses.textEn: both Mahlon and Kilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and her husband.

verses.textZh: 拿俄米还在摩押地的时候，因为听说耶和华眷顾他的子民，赐粮食给他们，就带着两个媳妇动身从摩押地回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米还在摩押地的时候，因为听说耶和华眷顾他的子民，赐粮食给他们，就带着两个媳妇动身从摩押地回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 她就与两个儿妇起身，要从摩押地归回；因为她在摩押地听见耶和华眷顾自己的百姓，赐粮食与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When Naomi heard in Moab that the Lord had come to the aid of his people by providing food for them, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to return home from there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law to return from the country of Moab, for she had heard in the fields of Moab that the Lord had visited his people and given them food.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law that she might return from the country of Moab, for she had heard in the country of Moab that the Lord had visited His people by giving them bread.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Naomi heard in Moab that the Lord had blessed his people in Judah by giving them good crops again. So Naomi and her daughters-in-law got ready to leave Moab to return to her homeland.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law to return from the land of Moab, because she had heard in the land of Moab that the Lord had visited His people by giving them food.
verses.textEn: When Naomi heard in Moab that the Lord had come to the aid of his people by providing food for them, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to return home from there.

verses.textZh: 她离开居住的地方，两个媳妇也随她出发，要回到犹大地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她离开居住的地方，两个媳妇也随她出发，要回到犹大地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是她和两个儿妇起行离开所住的地方，要回犹大地去。
verses.textEnNiv: With her two daughters-in-law she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road that would take them back to the land of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: So she set out from the place where she was with her two daughters-in-law, and they went on the way to return to the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore she went out from the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on the way to return to the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: With her two daughters-in-law she set out from the place where she had been living, and they took the road that would lead them back to Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: So she departed from the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on the way to return to the land of Judah.
verses.textEn: With her two daughters-in-law she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road that would take them back to the land of Judah.

verses.textZh: 拿俄米对两个媳妇说："去吧，你们还是各自回娘家吧。愿耶和华恩待你们，像你们善待已死的人和我一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米对两个媳妇说："去吧，你们还是各自回娘家吧。愿耶和华恩待你们，像你们善待已死的人和我一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米对两个儿妇说：「你们各人回娘家去吧。愿耶和华恩待你们，像你们恩待已死的人与我一样！
verses.textEnNiv: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go back, each of you, to your mother’s home. May the Lord show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to your dead husbands and to me.
verses.textEnEsv: But Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May the Lord deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go, return each to her mother’s house. The Lord deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
verses.textEnNlt: But on the way, Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go back to your mothers’ homes. And may the Lord reward you for your kindness to your husbands and to me.
verses.textEnNasb: But Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go, return each of you to your mother’s house. May the Lord deal kindly with you as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
verses.textEn: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go back, each of you, to your mother’s home. May the Lord show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to your dead husbands and to me.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华使你们各人有机会再嫁 ，找到归宿。"跟着亲吻她们，她们就发声大哭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华使你们各人有机会再嫁 ，找到归宿。"跟着亲吻她们，她们就发声大哭，
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华使你们各在新夫家中得平安！」于是拿俄米与她们亲嘴。她们就放声而哭，
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord grant that each of you will find rest in the home of another husband." Then she kissed them goodbye and they wept aloud
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord grant that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband!" Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices and wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord grant that you may find rest, each in the house of her husband." So she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices and wept.
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord bless you with the security of another marriage." Then she kissed them good-bye, and they all broke down and wept.
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord grant that you may find a place of rest, each one in the house of her husband." Then she kissed them, and they raised their voices and wept.
verses.textEn: May the Lord grant that each of you will find rest in the home of another husband." Then she kissed them goodbye and they wept aloud

verses.textZh: 说："不，我们一定要跟你一起回到你同胞那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："不，我们一定要跟你一起回到你同胞那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「不然，我们必与你一同回你本国去。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said to her, "We will go back with you to your people."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to her, "No, we will return with you to your people."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to her, "Surely we will return with you to your people."
verses.textEnNlt: "No," they said. "We want to go with you to your people."
verses.textEnNasb: However, they said to her, "No, but we will return with you to your people."
verses.textEn: and said to her, "We will go back with you to your people."

verses.textZh: 拿俄米说："我女儿啊，你们回去吧，为甚么要跟我去呢？我肚子里还有儿子作你们的丈夫吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米说："我女儿啊，你们回去吧，为甚么要跟我去呢？我肚子里还有儿子作你们的丈夫吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米说：「我女儿们哪，回去吧！为何要跟我去呢？我还能生子作你们的丈夫吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But Naomi said, "Return home, my daughters. Why would you come with me? Am I going to have any more sons, who could become your husbands?
verses.textEnEsv: But Naomi said, "Turn back, my daughters; why will you go with me? Have I yet sons in my womb that they may become your husbands?
verses.textEnNkjv: But Naomi said, "Turn back, my daughters; why will you go with me? Are there still sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
verses.textEnNlt: But Naomi replied, "Why should you go on with me? Can I still give birth to other sons who could grow up to be your husbands?
verses.textEnNasb: But Naomi said, "Return, my daughters. Why should you go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
verses.textEn: But Naomi said, "Return home, my daughters. Why would you come with me? Am I going to have any more sons, who could become your husbands?

verses.textZh: 走吧，我女儿啊，你们回去吧，因为我太老，不能嫁人了，就算我说我还有希望今天晚上有个丈夫，又生儿子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 走吧，我女儿啊，你们回去吧，因为我太老，不能嫁人了，就算我说我还有希望今天晚上有个丈夫，又生儿子，
verses.textZhCuv: 我女儿们哪，回去吧！我年纪老迈，不能再有丈夫；即或说，我还有指望，今夜有丈夫可以生子，
verses.textEnNiv: Return home, my daughters; I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was still hope for me—even if I had a husband tonight and then gave birth to sons—
verses.textEnEsv: Turn back, my daughters; go your way, for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say I have hope, even if I should have a husband this night and should bear sons,
verses.textEnNkjv: Turn back, my daughters, go—for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say I have hope, if I should have a husband tonight and should also bear sons,
verses.textEnNlt: No, my daughters, return to your parents’ homes, for I am too old to marry again. And even if it were possible, and I were to get married tonight and bear sons, then what?
verses.textEnNasb: Return, my daughters! Go, for I am too old to have a husband. If I said I have hope, if I were even to have a husband tonight and also give birth to sons,
verses.textEn: Return home, my daughters; I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was still hope for me—even if I had a husband tonight and then gave birth to sons—

verses.textZh: 你们可以等到他们长大吗？你们可以为他们守节而不嫁人吗？不行，我女儿啊，我为你们非常难过，因为耶和华伸手对付我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们可以等到他们长大吗？你们可以为他们守节而不嫁人吗？不行，我女儿啊，我为你们非常难过，因为耶和华伸手对付我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们岂能等着他们长大呢？你们岂能等着他们不嫁别人呢？我女儿们哪，不要这样。我为你们的缘故甚是愁苦，因为耶和华伸手攻击我。」
verses.textEnNiv: would you wait until they grew up? Would you remain unmarried for them? No, my daughters. It is more bitter for me than for you, because the Lord ’s hand has turned against me!"
verses.textEnEsv: would you therefore wait till they were grown? Would you therefore refrain from marrying? No, my daughters, for it is exceedingly bitter to me for your sake that the hand of the Lord has gone out against me."
verses.textEnNkjv: would you wait for them till they were grown? Would you restrain yourselves from having husbands? No, my daughters; for it grieves me very much for your sakes that the hand of the Lord has gone out against me!"
verses.textEnNlt: Would you wait for them to grow up and refuse to marry someone else? No, of course not, my daughters! Things are far more bitter for me than for you, because the Lord himself has raised his fist against me."
verses.textEnNasb: would you therefore wait until they were grown? Would you therefore refrain from marrying? No, my daughters; for it is much more bitter for me than for you, because the hand of the Lord has come out against me."
verses.textEn: would you wait until they grew up? Would you remain unmarried for them? No, my daughters. It is more bitter for me than for you, because the Lord ’s hand has turned against me!"

verses.textZh: 她们又放声大哭。俄耳巴就和婆婆吻别，路得却舍不得离开拿俄米。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们又放声大哭。俄耳巴就和婆婆吻别，路得却舍不得离开拿俄米。
verses.textZhCuv: 两个儿妇又放声而哭，俄珥巴与婆婆亲嘴而别，只是路得舍不得拿俄米。
verses.textEnNiv: At this they wept aloud again. Then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they lifted up their voices and wept again. And Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clung to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they lifted up their voices and wept again; and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clung to her.
verses.textEnNlt: And again they wept together, and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law good-bye. But Ruth clung tightly to Naomi.
verses.textEnNasb: And they raised their voices and wept again; and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clung to her.
verses.textEn: At this they wept aloud again. Then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.

verses.textZh: 拿俄米说："你看，你嫂嫂已经回到她同胞和她的神那里去了。你也跟着嫂嫂回去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米说："你看，你嫂嫂已经回到她同胞和她的神那里去了。你也跟着嫂嫂回去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米说：「看哪，你嫂子已经回她本国和她所拜的神那里去了，你也跟着你嫂子回去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Look," said Naomi, "your sister-in-law is going back to her people and her gods. Go back with her."
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "See, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods; return after your sister-in-law."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said, "Look, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods; return after your sister-in-law."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look," Naomi said to her, "your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods. You should do the same."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said, "Behold, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her gods; return after your sister-in-law."
verses.textEn: "Look," said Naomi, "your sister-in-law is going back to her people and her gods. Go back with her."

verses.textZh: 路得说："请不要逼我离开你回去，不跟从你。你到哪里去，我也要到哪里去；你在哪里过夜，我也要在哪里过夜；你的同胞就是我的同胞，你的神就是我的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 路得说："请不要逼我离开你回去，不跟从你。你到哪里去，我也要到哪里去；你在哪里过夜，我也要在哪里过夜；你的同胞就是我的同胞，你的神就是我的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 路得说：「不要催我回去不跟随你。你往哪里去，我也往那里去；你在哪里住宿，我也在那里住宿；你的国就是我的国，你的神就是我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: But Ruth replied, "Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.
verses.textEnEsv: But Ruth said, "Do not urge me to leave you or to return from following you. For where you go I will go, and where you lodge I will lodge. Your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Ruth said: "Entreat me not to leave you, Orto turn back from following after you; For wherever you go, I will go; And wherever you lodge, I will lodge; Your people shallbe my people, And your God, my God.
verses.textEnNlt: But Ruth replied, "Don’t ask me to leave you and turn back. Wherever you go, I will go; wherever you live, I will live. Your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.
verses.textEnNasb: But Ruth said, "Do not plead with me to leave you or to turn back from following you; for where you go, I will go, and where you sleep, I will sleep. Your people shall be my people, and your God, my God.
verses.textEn: But Ruth replied, "Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.

verses.textZh: 你死在哪里，我也要死在哪里，葬在哪里。除非死亡把你我分离；如果我离开你，愿耶和华加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你死在哪里，我也要死在哪里，葬在哪里。除非死亡把你我分离；如果我离开你，愿耶和华加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你在哪里死，我也在那里死，也葬在那里。除非死能使你我相离！不然，愿耶和华重重地降罚与我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Where you die I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord deal with me, be it ever so severely, if even death separates you and me."
verses.textEnEsv: Where you die I will die, and there will I be buried. May the Lord do so to me and more also if anything but death parts me from you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Where you die, I will die, And there will I be buried. The Lord do so to me, and more also, If anythingbut death parts you and me."
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord punish me severely if I allow anything but death to separate us!"
verses.textEnNasb: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord do so to me, and worse, if anything but death separates me from you."
verses.textEn: Where you die I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord deal with me, be it ever so severely, if even death separates you and me."

verses.textZh: 拿俄米看路得坚决要跟她走，就不再多费唇舌了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米看路得坚决要跟她走，就不再多费唇舌了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米见路得定意要跟随自己去，就不再劝她了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Naomi realized that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she said no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: When she saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped speaking to her.
verses.textEnNlt: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she said nothing more.
verses.textEnNasb: When she saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped speaking to her about it.
verses.textEn: When Naomi realized that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

verses.textZh: 她们双双上路，来到伯利恒。她们到达的时候，全城都因她们的缘故骚动起来。妇女们说："这是拿俄米吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们双双上路，来到伯利恒。她们到达的时候，全城都因她们的缘故骚动起来。妇女们说："这是拿俄米吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是二人同行，来到伯利恒。她们到了伯利恒，合城的人就都惊讶。妇女们说：「这是拿俄米吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: So the two women went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they arrived in Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women exclaimed, "Can this be Naomi?"
verses.textEnEsv: So the two of them went on until they came to Bethlehem. And when they came to Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them. And the women said, "Is this Naomi?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the two of them went until they came to Bethlehem. And it happened, when they had come to Bethlehem, that all the city was excited because of them; and the women said, "Is this Naomi?"
verses.textEnNlt: So the two of them continued on their journey. When they came to Bethlehem, the entire town was excited by their arrival. "Is it really Naomi?" the women asked.
verses.textEnNasb: So they both went on until they came to Bethlehem. And when they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was stirred because of them, and the women said, "Is this Naomi?"
verses.textEn: So the two women went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they arrived in Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women exclaimed, "Can this be Naomi?"

verses.textZh: 拿俄米对她们说："不要叫我拿俄米，叫我玛拉吧，因为全能者使我吃尽了苦头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米对她们说："不要叫我拿俄米，叫我玛拉吧，因为全能者使我吃尽了苦头。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米对她们说：「不要叫我拿俄米 ，要叫我玛拉 ，因为全能者使我受了大苦。
verses.textEnNiv: "Don’t call me Naomi, " she told them. "Call me Mara, because the Almighty has made my life very bitter.
verses.textEnEsv: She said to them, "Do not call me Naomi; call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But she said to them, "Do not call me Naomi; call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t call me Naomi," she responded. "Instead, call me Mara, for the Almighty has made life very bitter for me.
verses.textEnNasb: But she said to them, "Do not call me Naomi; call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
verses.textEn: "Don’t call me Naomi, " she told them. "Call me Mara, because the Almighty has made my life very bitter.

verses.textZh: 我满满地出去，耶和华却使我空空地回来，你们为甚么还叫我拿俄米呢？耶和华折磨我，全能者加害于我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我满满地出去，耶和华却使我空空地回来，你们为甚么还叫我拿俄米呢？耶和华折磨我，全能者加害于我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我满满地出去，耶和华使我空空地回来。耶和华降祸与我；全能者使我受苦。既是这样，你们为何还叫我拿俄米呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? The Lord has afflicted me; the Almighty has brought misfortune upon me."
verses.textEnEsv: I went away full, and the Lord has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi, when the Lord has testified against me and the Almighty has brought calamity upon me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: I went out full, and the Lord has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the Lord has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?"
verses.textEnNlt: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me home empty. Why call me Naomi when the Lord has caused me to suffer and the Almighty has sent such tragedy upon me?"
verses.textEnNasb: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the Lord has testified against me and the Almighty has afflicted me?"
verses.textEn: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? The Lord has afflicted me; the Almighty has brought misfortune upon me."

verses.textZh: 拿俄米就这样回来了。她媳妇摩押女子路得随着她从摩押地回来。她们到达伯利恒，正是开始收割大麦的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米就这样回来了。她媳妇摩押女子路得随着她从摩押地回来。她们到达伯利恒，正是开始收割大麦的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米和她儿妇摩押女子路得，从摩押地回来到伯利恒，正是动手割大麦的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: So Naomi returned from Moab accompanied by Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, arriving in Bethlehem as the barley harvest was beginning.
verses.textEnEsv: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabite her daughter-in-law with her, who returned from the country of Moab. And they came to Bethlehem at the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess her daughter-in-law with her, who returned from the country of Moab. Now they came to Bethlehem at the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.textEnNlt: So Naomi returned from Moab, accompanied by her daughter-in-law Ruth, the young Moabite woman. They arrived in Bethlehem in late spring, at the beginning of the barley harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: So Naomi returned, and with her Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, who returned from the land of Moab. And they came to Bethlehem at the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.textEn: So Naomi returned from Moab accompanied by Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, arriving in Bethlehem as the barley harvest was beginning.

verses.textZh: 拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒有个同族的亲戚，名叫波阿斯，是个大财主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒有个同族的亲戚，名叫波阿斯，是个大财主。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米的丈夫以利米勒的亲族中，有一个人名叫波阿斯，是个大财主。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a man of standing from the clan of Elimelek, whose name was Boaz.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a worthy man of the clan of Elimelech, whose name was Boaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was a relative of Naomi’s husband, a man of great wealth, of the family of Elimelech. His name was Boaz.
verses.textEnNlt: Now there was a wealthy and influential man in Bethlehem named Boaz, who was a relative of Naomi’s husband, Elimelech.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Naomi had a relative of her husband, a man of great wealth, of the family of Elimelech, whose name was Boaz.
verses.textEn: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a man of standing from the clan of Elimelek, whose name was Boaz.

verses.textZh: 摩押女子路得对拿俄米说："让我到田里去，我在谁的眼前蒙恩，我就跟在谁的背后捡麦穗。"拿俄米说："女儿啊，你尽管去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押女子路得对拿俄米说："让我到田里去，我在谁的眼前蒙恩，我就跟在谁的背后捡麦穗。"拿俄米说："女儿啊，你尽管去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押女子路得对拿俄米说：「容我往田间去，我蒙谁的恩，就在谁的身后拾取麦穗。」拿俄米说：「女儿啊，你只管去。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, "Let me go to the fields and pick up the leftover grain behind anyone in whose eyes I find favor." Naomi said to her, "Go ahead, my daughter."
verses.textEnEsv: And Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, "Let me go to the field and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I shall find favor." And she said to her, "Go, my daughter."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, "Please let me go to the field, and glean heads of grain after him in whose sight I may find favor." And she said to her, "Go, my daughter."
verses.textEnNlt: One day Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, "Let me go out into the harvest fields to pick up the stalks of grain left behind by anyone who is kind enough to let me do it." Naomi replied, "All right, my daughter, go ahead."
verses.textEnNasb: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, "Please let me go to the field and glean among the ears of grain following one in whose eyes I may find favor." And she said to her, "Go, my daughter."
verses.textEn: And Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, "Let me go to the fields and pick up the leftover grain behind anyone in whose eyes I find favor." Naomi said to her, "Go ahead, my daughter."

verses.textZh: 路得就去了，来到田里，在收割的人背后捡麦穗。她恰巧来到以利米勒同族的人波阿斯那块田。
verses.textZhCnvs: 路得就去了，来到田里，在收割的人背后捡麦穗。她恰巧来到以利米勒同族的人波阿斯那块田。
verses.textZhCuv: 路得就去了，来到田间，在收割的人身后拾取麦穗。她恰巧到了以利米勒本族的人波阿斯那块田里。
verses.textEnNiv: So she went out, entered a field and began to glean behind the harvesters. As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: So she set out and went and gleaned in the field after the reapers, and she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the clan of Elimelech.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she left, and went and gleaned in the field after the reapers. And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ruth went out to gather grain behind the harvesters. And as it happened, she found herself working in a field that belonged to Boaz, the relative of her father-in-law, Elimelech.
verses.textEnNasb: So she left and went and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
verses.textEn: So she went out, entered a field and began to glean behind the harvesters. As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelek.

verses.textZh: 波阿斯刚好从伯利恒来，对收割的人说："愿耶和华与你们同在。"他们回答："愿耶和华赐福与你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯刚好从伯利恒来，对收割的人说："愿耶和华与你们同在。"他们回答："愿耶和华赐福与你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯正从伯利恒来，对收割的人说：「愿耶和华与你们同在！」他们回答说：「愿耶和华赐福与你！」
verses.textEnNiv: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters, "The Lord be with you!" "The Lord bless you!" they answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem. And he said to the reapers, "The Lord be with you!" And they answered, "The Lord bless you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, "The Lordbe with you!" And they answered him, "The Lord bless you!"
verses.textEnNlt: While she was there, Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters. "The Lord be with you!" he said. "The Lord bless you!" the harvesters replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem and said to the reapers, "May the Lord be with you." And they said to him, "May the Lord bless you."
verses.textEn: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters, "The Lord be with you!" "The Lord bless you!" they answered.

verses.textZh: 波阿斯问那监督收割的仆人："那是谁家的姑娘呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯问那监督收割的仆人："那是谁家的姑娘呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯问监管收割的仆人说：「那是谁家的女子？」
verses.textEnNiv: Boaz asked the overseer of his harvesters, "Who does that young woman belong to?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Boaz said to his young man who was in charge of the reapers, "Whose young woman is this?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Boaz said to his servant who was in charge of the reapers, "Whose young woman is this?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Boaz asked his foreman, "Who is that young woman over there? Who does she belong to?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Boaz said to his servant who was in charge of the reapers, "Whose young woman is this?"
verses.textEn: Boaz asked the overseer of his harvesters, "Who does that young woman belong to?"

verses.textZh: 监督收割的仆人回答："她是跟拿俄米从摩押地回来的摩押女子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 监督收割的仆人回答："她是跟拿俄米从摩押地回来的摩押女子。
verses.textZhCuv: 监管收割的仆人回答说：「是那摩押女子，跟随拿俄米从摩押地回来的。
verses.textEnNiv: The overseer replied, "She is the Moabite who came back from Moab with Naomi.
verses.textEnEsv: And the servant who was in charge of the reapers answered, "She is the young Moabite woman, who came back with Naomi from the country of Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the servant who was in charge of the reapers answered and said, "It is the young Moabite woman who came back with Naomi from the country of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: And the foreman replied, "She is the young woman from Moab who came back with Naomi.
verses.textEnNasb: And the servant in charge of the reapers replied, "She is the young Moabite woman who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.
verses.textEn: The overseer replied, "She is the Moabite who came back from Moab with Naomi.

verses.textZh: 她说：‘请让我捡一点麦穗吧。让我跟在收割的人背后，在禾捆堆中捡些零碎的穗子。’于是她来了。除了在房子里休息了一会儿之外，从早晨到现在一直都留在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她说：‘请让我捡一点麦穗吧。让我跟在收割的人背后，在禾捆堆中捡些零碎的穗子。’于是她来了。除了在房子里休息了一会儿之外，从早晨到现在一直都留在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她说：『请你容我跟着收割的人拾取打捆剩下的麦穗。』她从早晨直到如今，除了在屋子里坐一会儿，常在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the harvesters.’ She came into the field and has remained here from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter."
verses.textEnEsv: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the reapers.’ So she came, and she has continued from early morning until now, except for a short rest."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came and has continued from morning until now, though she rested a little in the house."
verses.textEnNlt: She asked me this morning if she could gather grain behind the harvesters. She has been hard at work ever since, except for a few minutes’ rest in the shelter."
verses.textEnNasb: And she said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came and has remained from the morning until now; she has been sitting in the house for a little while."
verses.textEn: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the harvesters.’ She came into the field and has remained here from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter."

verses.textZh: 波阿斯对路得说："女儿啊，听我说，不要到别人田里去捡麦穗，也不要离开这里，要常常与我的女佣人在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯对路得说："女儿啊，听我说，不要到别人田里去捡麦穗，也不要离开这里，要常常与我的女佣人在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯对路得说：「女儿啊，听我说，不要往别人田里拾取麦穗，也不要离开这里，要常与我使女们在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: So Boaz said to Ruth, "My daughter, listen to me. Don’t go and glean in another field and don’t go away from here. Stay here with the women who work for me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Boaz said to Ruth, "Now, listen, my daughter, do not go to glean in another field or leave this one, but keep close to my young women.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Boaz said to Ruth, "You will listen, my daughter, will you not? Do not go to glean in another field, nor go from here, but stay close by my young women.
verses.textEnNlt: Boaz went over and said to Ruth, "Listen, my daughter. Stay right here with us when you gather grain; don’t go to any other fields. Stay right behind the young women working in my field.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Boaz said to Ruth, " Listen carefully, my daughter. Do not go to glean in another field; furthermore, do not go on from this one, but join my young women here.
verses.textEn: So Boaz said to Ruth, "My daughter, listen to me. Don’t go and glean in another field and don’t go away from here. Stay here with the women who work for me.

verses.textZh: 你看他们在哪块田里收割，就跟着女佣人去。我不是已经吩咐仆人不可欺负你吗？假如你渴了，就到水缸那里去，喝仆人打来的水。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看他们在哪块田里收割，就跟着女佣人去。我不是已经吩咐仆人不可欺负你吗？假如你渴了，就到水缸那里去，喝仆人打来的水。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仆人在那块田收割，你就跟着他们去。我已经吩咐仆人不可欺负你；你若渴了，就可以到器皿那里喝仆人打来的水。」
verses.textEnNiv: Watch the field where the men are harvesting, and follow along after the women. I have told the men not to lay a hand on you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and get a drink from the water jars the men have filled."
verses.textEnEsv: Let your eyes be on the field that they are reaping, and go after them. Have I not charged the young men not to touch you? And when you are thirsty, go to the vessels and drink what the young men have drawn."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let your eyes be on the field which they reap, and go after them. Have I not commanded the young men not to touch you? And when you are thirsty, go to the vessels and drink from what the young men have drawn."
verses.textEnNlt: See which part of the field they are harvesting, and then follow them. I have warned the young men not to treat you roughly. And when you are thirsty, help yourself to the water they have drawn from the well."
verses.textEnNasb: Keep your eyes on the field which they reap, and go after them. Indeed, I have ordered the servants not to touch you. When you are thirsty, go to the water jars and drink from what the servants draw."
verses.textEn: Watch the field where the men are harvesting, and follow along after the women. I have told the men not to lay a hand on you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and get a drink from the water jars the men have filled."

verses.textZh: 路得就俯伏在地叩拜，对他说："我是个外族人，为甚么会在你眼前蒙恩，蒙你关照呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 路得就俯伏在地叩拜，对他说："我是个外族人，为甚么会在你眼前蒙恩，蒙你关照呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 路得就俯伏在地叩拜，对他说：「我既是外邦人，怎么蒙你的恩，这样顾恤我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground. She asked him, "Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you notice me—a foreigner?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then she fell on her face, bowing to the ground, and said to him, "Why have I found favor in your eyes, that you should take notice of me, since I am a foreigner?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So she fell on her face, bowed down to the ground, and said to him, "Why have I found favor in your eyes, that you should take notice of me, since I am a foreigner?"
verses.textEnNlt: Ruth fell at his feet and thanked him warmly. "What have I done to deserve such kindness?" she asked. "I am only a foreigner."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she fell on her face, bowing to the ground, and said to him, "Why have I found favor in your sight that you should take notice of me, since I am a foreigner?"
verses.textEn: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground. She asked him, "Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you notice me—a foreigner?"

verses.textZh: 波阿斯回答她说："自从你丈夫去世以后，你对婆婆所行的，和你怎样离开父母与出生之地，来到素来不认识的人中间，这一切我都知道得很清楚了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯回答她说："自从你丈夫去世以后，你对婆婆所行的，和你怎样离开父母与出生之地，来到素来不认识的人中间，这一切我都知道得很清楚了。
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯回答说：「自从你丈夫死后，凡你向婆婆所行的，并你离开父母和本地，到素不认识的民中，这些事人全都告诉我了。
verses.textEnNiv: Boaz replied, "I’ve been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband—how you left your father and mother and your homeland and came to live with a people you did not know before.
verses.textEnEsv: But Boaz answered her, "All that you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband has been fully told to me, and how you left your father and mother and your native land and came to a people that you did not know before.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Boaz answered and said to her, "It has been fully reported to me, all that you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father and your mother and the land of your birth, and have come to a people whom you did not know before.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, I know," Boaz replied. "But I also know about everything you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband. I have heard how you left your father and mother and your own land to live here among complete strangers.
verses.textEnNasb: Boaz replied to her, "All that you have done for your mother-in-law after the death of your husband has been fully reported to me, and how you left your father and your mother and the land of your birth, and came to a people that you did not previously know.
verses.textEn: Boaz replied, "I’ve been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband—how you left your father and mother and your homeland and came to live with a people you did not know before.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华照你所作的报答你；你来投靠在耶和华以色列神的翅膀下，愿他充充足足酬报你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华照你所作的报答你；你来投靠在耶和华以色列神的翅膀下，愿他充充足足酬报你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华照你所行的赏赐你。你来投靠耶和华－以色列神的翅膀下，愿你满得他的赏赐。」
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord repay you for what you have done. May you be richly rewarded by the Lord , the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord repay you for what you have done, and a full reward be given you by the Lord , the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord repay your work, and a full reward be given you by the Lord God of Israel, under whose wings you have come for refuge."
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord , the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge, reward you fully for what you have done."
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord reward your work, and may your wages be full from the Lord, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge."
verses.textEn: May the Lord repay you for what you have done. May you be richly rewarded by the Lord , the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge."

verses.textZh: 路得说："主人啊，但愿我在你眼前蒙恩，虽然我连你的婢女都不是，你还是安慰我，对我这么好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 路得说："主人啊，但愿我在你眼前蒙恩，虽然我连你的婢女都不是，你还是安慰我，对我这么好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 路得说：「我主啊，愿在你眼前蒙恩。我虽然不及你的一个使女，你还用慈爱的话安慰我的心。」
verses.textEnNiv: "May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord," she said. "You have put me at ease by speaking kindly to your servant—though I do not have the standing of one of your servants."
verses.textEnEsv: Then she said, "I have found favor in your eyes, my lord, for you have comforted me and spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not one of your servants."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said, "Let me find favor in your sight, my lord; for you have comforted me, and have spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your maidservants."
verses.textEnNlt: "I hope I continue to please you, sir," she replied. "You have comforted me by speaking so kindly to me, even though I am not one of your workers."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said, "I have found favor in your sight, my lord, for you have comforted me and indeed have spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not like one of your female servants."
verses.textEn: "May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord," she said. "You have put me at ease by speaking kindly to your servant—though I do not have the standing of one of your servants."

verses.textZh: 到了吃饭的时候，波阿斯对路得说："你过来，吃一点饼吧，拿饼块蘸在醋里。"路得就在收割的人旁边坐下来。波阿斯把一些烘好的麦穗递给她，她吃饱了，还有剩下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了吃饭的时候，波阿斯对路得说："你过来，吃一点饼吧，拿饼块蘸在醋里。"路得就在收割的人旁边坐下来。波阿斯把一些烘好的麦穗递给她，她吃饱了，还有剩下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了吃饭的时候，波阿斯对路得说：「你到这里来吃饼，将饼蘸在醋里。」路得就在收割的人旁边坐下；他们把烘了的穗子递给她。她吃饱了，还有余剩的。
verses.textEnNiv: At mealtime Boaz said to her, "Come over here. Have some bread and dip it in the wine vinegar." When she sat down with the harvesters, he offered her some roasted grain. She ate all she wanted and had some left over.
verses.textEnEsv: And at mealtime Boaz said to her, "Come here and eat some bread and dip your morsel in the wine." So she sat beside the reapers, and he passed to her roasted grain. And she ate until she was satisfied, and she had some left over.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Boaz said to her at mealtime, "Come here, and eat of the bread, and dip your piece of bread in the vinegar." So she sat beside the reapers, and he passed parched grain to her; and she ate and was satisfied, and kept some back.
verses.textEnNlt: At mealtime Boaz called to her, "Come over here, and help yourself to some food. You can dip your bread in the sour wine." So she sat with his harvesters, and Boaz gave her some roasted grain to eat. She ate all she wanted and still had some left over.
verses.textEnNasb: And at mealtime Boaz said to her, " Come here, that you may eat of the bread and dip your piece of bread in the vinegar." So she sat beside the reapers; and he served her roasted grain, and she ate and was satisfied and had some left.
verses.textEn: At mealtime Boaz said to her, "Come over here. Have some bread and dip it in the wine vinegar." When she sat down with the harvesters, he offered her some roasted grain. She ate all she wanted and had some left over.

verses.textZh: 她再起来去捡麦穗的时候，波阿斯吩咐仆人说："就算她在禾捆堆中捡麦穗，也不可以辱骂她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她再起来去捡麦穗的时候，波阿斯吩咐仆人说："就算她在禾捆堆中捡麦穗，也不可以辱骂她。
verses.textZhCuv: 她起来又拾取麦穗，波阿斯吩咐仆人说：「她就是在捆中拾取麦穗，也可以容她，不可羞辱她；
verses.textEnNiv: As she got up to glean, Boaz gave orders to his men, "Let her gather among the sheaves and don’t reprimand her.
verses.textEnEsv: When she rose to glean, Boaz instructed his young men, saying, "Let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not reproach her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when she rose up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, "Let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not reproach her.
verses.textEnNlt: When Ruth went back to work again, Boaz ordered his young men, "Let her gather grain right among the sheaves without stopping her.
verses.textEnNasb: When she got up to glean, Boaz commanded his servants, saying, "Let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not insult her.
verses.textEn: As she got up to glean, Boaz gave orders to his men, "Let her gather among the sheaves and don’t reprimand her.

verses.textZh: 甚至要故意为她从禾捆中抽些出来，留给她去捡，千万不可责备她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚至要故意为她从禾捆中抽些出来，留给她去捡，千万不可责备她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并要从捆里抽出些来，留在地下任她拾取，不可叱吓她。」
verses.textEnNiv: Even pull out some stalks for her from the bundles and leave them for her to pick up, and don’t rebuke her."
verses.textEnEsv: And also pull out some from the bundles for her and leave it for her to glean, and do not rebuke her."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also let grain from the bundles fall purposely for her; leave it that she may glean, and do not rebuke her."
verses.textEnNlt: And pull out some heads of barley from the bundles and drop them on purpose for her. Let her pick them up, and don’t give her a hard time!"
verses.textEnNasb: Also you are to purposely slip out for her some grain from the bundles and leave it so that she may glean, and do not rebuke her."
verses.textEn: Even pull out some stalks for her from the bundles and leave them for her to pick up, and don’t rebuke her."

verses.textZh: 路得就这样在田里捡麦穗，直到傍晚。她把捡来的麦穗打了，约有二十二公升大麦，
verses.textZhCnvs: 路得就这样在田里捡麦穗，直到傍晚。她把捡来的麦穗打了，约有二十二公升大麦，
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，路得在田间拾取麦穗，直到晚上，将所拾取的打了，约有一伊法大麦。
verses.textEnNiv: So Ruth gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed the barley she had gathered, and it amounted to about an ephah.
verses.textEnEsv: So she gleaned in the field until evening. Then she beat out what she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she gleaned in the field until evening, and beat out what she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ruth gathered barley there all day, and when she beat out the grain that evening, it filled an entire basket.
verses.textEnNasb: So she gleaned in the field until evening. Then she beat out what she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah of barley.
verses.textEn: So Ruth gleaned in the field until evening. Then she threshed the barley she had gathered, and it amounted to about an ephah.

verses.textZh: 然后带回城里去。路得把捡来的麦子拿给婆婆看，把吃剩的给了婆婆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后带回城里去。路得把捡来的麦子拿给婆婆看，把吃剩的给了婆婆。
verses.textZhCuv: 她就把所拾取的带进城去给婆婆看，又把她吃饱了所剩的给了婆婆。
verses.textEnNiv: She carried it back to town, and her mother-in-law saw how much she had gathered. Ruth also brought out and gave her what she had left over after she had eaten enough.
verses.textEnEsv: And she took it up and went into the city. Her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. She also brought out and gave her what food she had left over after being satisfied.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she took it up and went into the city, and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. So she brought out and gave to her what she had kept back after she had been satisfied.
verses.textEnNlt: She carried it back into town and showed it to her mother-in-law. Ruth also gave her the roasted grain that was left over from her meal.
verses.textEnNasb: And she picked it up and went into the city, and her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. She also took some out and gave Naomi what she had left after she was satisfied.
verses.textEn: She carried it back to town, and her mother-in-law saw how much she had gathered. Ruth also brought out and gave her what she had left over after she had eaten enough.

verses.textZh: 婆婆问她："你今天在哪里捡麦穗？在哪里工作呢？愿那关照你的人蒙福。"路得就告诉婆婆她在谁那里工作，说："我今天在一个名叫波阿斯的人那里工作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 婆婆问她："你今天在哪里捡麦穗？在哪里工作呢？愿那关照你的人蒙福。"路得就告诉婆婆她在谁那里工作，说："我今天在一个名叫波阿斯的人那里工作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 婆婆问她说：「你今日在哪里拾取麦穗，在哪里做工呢？愿那顾恤你的得福。」路得就告诉婆婆说：「我今日在一个名叫波阿斯的人那里做工。」
verses.textEnNiv: Her mother-in-law asked her, "Where did you glean today? Where did you work? Blessed be the man who took notice of you!" Then Ruth told her mother-in-law about the one at whose place she had been working. "The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz," she said.
verses.textEnEsv: And her mother-in-law said to her, "Where did you glean today? And where have you worked? Blessed be the man who took notice of you." So she told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked and said, "The man’s name with whom I worked today is Boaz."
verses.textEnNkjv: And her mother-in-law said to her, "Where have you gleaned today? And where did you work? Blessed be the one who took notice of you." So she told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, and said, "The man’s name with whom I worked today is Boaz."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where did you gather all this grain today?" Naomi asked. "Where did you work? May the Lord bless the one who helped you!" So Ruth told her mother-in-law about the man in whose field she had worked. She said, "The man I worked with today is named Boaz."
verses.textEnNasb: Her mother-in-law then said to her, "Where did you glean today and where did you work? May he who took notice of you be blessed." So she told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked, and said, "The name of the man with whom I worked today is Boaz."
verses.textEn: Her mother-in-law asked her, "Where did you glean today? Where did you work? Blessed be the man who took notice of you!" Then Ruth told her mother-in-law about the one at whose place she had been working. "The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz," she said.

verses.textZh: 拿俄米对媳妇说："愿不断施慈爱给活人和死人的耶和华赐福给他。"拿俄米又对她说："这个人是我们的亲人，有买赎权的一位近亲。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米对媳妇说："愿不断施慈爱给活人和死人的耶和华赐福给他。"拿俄米又对她说："这个人是我们的亲人，有买赎权的一位近亲。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米对儿妇说：「愿那人蒙耶和华赐福，因为他不断地恩待活人死人。」拿俄米又说：「那是我们本族的人，是一个至近的亲属。」
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord bless him!" Naomi said to her daughter-in-law. "He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead." She added, "That man is our close relative; he is one of our guardian-redeemers. "
verses.textEnEsv: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, "May he be blessed by the Lord , whose kindness has not forsaken the living or the dead!" Naomi also said to her, "The man is a close relative of ours, one of our redeemers."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, "Blessed be he of the Lord, who has not forsaken His kindness to the living and the dead!" And Naomi said to her, "This man is a relation of ours, one of our close relatives."
verses.textEnNlt: "May the Lord bless him!" Naomi told her daughter-in-law. "He is showing his kindness to us as well as to your dead husband. That man is one of our closest relatives, one of our family redeemers."
verses.textEnNasb: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, "May he be blessed of the Lord who has not withdrawn His kindness from the living and from the dead." Again Naomi said to her, "The man is our relative; he is one of our redeemers."
verses.textEn: "The Lord bless him!" Naomi said to her daughter-in-law. "He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead." She added, "That man is our close relative; he is one of our guardian-redeemers. "

verses.textZh: 摩押女子路得说："他还告诉我：‘紧跟着我的仆人捡麦穗，直到全部收割完毕。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押女子路得说："他还告诉我：‘紧跟着我的仆人捡麦穗，直到全部收割完毕。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押女子路得说：「他对我说：『你要紧随我的仆人拾取麦穗，直等他们收完了我的庄稼。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Ruth the Moabite said, "He even said to me, ‘Stay with my workers until they finish harvesting all my grain.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And Ruth the Moabite said, "Besides, he said to me, ‘You shall keep close by my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Ruth the Moabitess said, "He also said to me, ‘You shall stay close by my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ruth said, "What’s more, Boaz even told me to come back and stay with his harvesters until the entire harvest is completed."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ruth the Moabitess said, " Furthermore, he said to me, ‘You are to stay close to my servants until they have finished all my harvest.’ "
verses.textEn: Then Ruth the Moabite said, "He even said to me, ‘Stay with my workers until they finish harvesting all my grain.’ "

verses.textZh: 拿俄米对媳妇路得说："我女儿啊，这样才好，要与他的女佣人一起去，免得在别人的田里遭受敌视。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米对媳妇路得说："我女儿啊，这样才好，要与他的女佣人一起去，免得在别人的田里遭受敌视。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米对儿妇路得说：「女儿啊，你跟着他的使女出去，不叫人遇见你在别人田间，这才为好。」
verses.textEnNiv: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, "It will be good for you, my daughter, to go with the women who work for him, because in someone else’s field you might be harmed."
verses.textEnEsv: And Naomi said to Ruth, her daughter-in-law, "It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his young women, lest in another field you be assaulted."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, "Itis good, my daughter, that you go out with his young women, and that people do not meet you in any other field."
verses.textEnNlt: "Good!" Naomi exclaimed. "Do as he said, my daughter. Stay with his young women right through the whole harvest. You might be harassed in other fields, but you’ll be safe with him."
verses.textEnNasb: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law Ruth, "It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his young women, so that others do not assault you in another field."
verses.textEn: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, "It will be good for you, my daughter, to go with the women who work for him, because in someone else’s field you might be harmed."

verses.textZh: 她就紧跟着波阿斯的女佣人捡麦穗，直到大麦和小麦都收割好了。路得一直与婆婆住在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她就紧跟着波阿斯的女佣人捡麦穗，直到大麦和小麦都收割好了。路得一直与婆婆住在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是路得与波阿斯的使女常在一处拾取麦穗，直到收完了大麦和小麦。路得仍与婆婆同住。
verses.textEnNiv: So Ruth stayed close to the women of Boaz to glean until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
verses.textEnEsv: So she kept close to the young women of Boaz, gleaning until the end of the barley and wheat harvests. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she stayed close by the young women of Boaz, to glean until the end of barley harvest and wheat harvest; and she dwelt with her mother-in-law.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ruth worked alongside the women in Boaz’s fields and gathered grain with them until the end of the barley harvest. Then she continued working with them through the wheat harvest in early summer. And all the while she lived with her mother-in-law.
verses.textEnNasb: So she stayed close by the young women of Boaz in order to glean until the end of the barley harvest and the wheat harvest. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
verses.textEn: So Ruth stayed close to the women of Boaz to glean until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.

verses.textZh: 路得的婆婆拿俄米对她说："女儿啊，我不是应当为你找个归宿，使你得到幸福吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 路得的婆婆拿俄米对她说："女儿啊，我不是应当为你找个归宿，使你得到幸福吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 路得的婆婆拿俄米对她说：「女儿啊，我不当为你找个安身之处，使你享福吗？
verses.textEnNiv: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her, "My daughter, I must find a home for you, where you will be well provided for.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, "My daughter, should I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, "My daughter, shall I not seek security for you, that it may be well with you?
verses.textEnNlt: One day Naomi said to Ruth, "My daughter, it’s time that I found a permanent home for you, so that you will be provided for.
verses.textEnNasb: Then her mother-in-law Naomi said to her, "My daughter, shall I not seek security for you, that it may go well for you?
verses.textEn: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her, "My daughter, I must find a home for you, where you will be well provided for.

verses.textZh: 你常常和他的女佣人在一起的波阿斯不是我们的亲戚吗？他今天晚上要在禾场上簸大麦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你常常和他的女佣人在一起的波阿斯不是我们的亲戚吗？他今天晚上要在禾场上簸大麦。
verses.textZhCuv: 你与波阿斯的使女常在一处，波阿斯不是我们的亲族吗？他今夜在场上簸大麦；
verses.textEnNiv: Now Boaz, with whose women you have worked, is a relative of ours. Tonight he will be winnowing barley on the threshing floor.
verses.textEnEsv: Is not Boaz our relative, with whose young women you were? See, he is winnowing barley tonight at the threshing floor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Boaz, whose young women you were with, ishe not our relative? In fact, he is winnowing barley tonight at the threshing floor.
verses.textEnNlt: Boaz is a close relative of ours, and he’s been very kind by letting you gather grain with his young women. Tonight he will be winnowing barley at the threshing floor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, is Boaz not our relative, with whose young women you were? Behold, he is winnowing barley at the threshing floor tonight.
verses.textEn: Now Boaz, with whose women you have worked, is a relative of ours. Tonight he will be winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

verses.textZh: 你洗个澡，抹上香膏，穿上斗篷，就下到禾场去。不过，那个人还没有吃喝完毕，别让他认出你来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你洗个澡，抹上香膏，穿上斗篷，就下到禾场去。不过，那个人还没有吃喝完毕，别让他认出你来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要沐浴抹膏，换上衣服，下到场上，却不要使那人认出你来。你等他吃喝完了，
verses.textEnNiv: Wash, put on perfume, and get dressed in your best clothes. Then go down to the threshing floor, but don’t let him know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.
verses.textEnEsv: Wash therefore and anoint yourself, and put on your cloak and go down to the threshing floor, but do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore wash yourself and anoint yourself, put on your best garment and go down to the threshing floor; but do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
verses.textEnNlt: Now do as I tell you—take a bath and put on perfume and dress in your nicest clothes. Then go to the threshing floor, but don’t let Boaz see you until he has finished eating and drinking.
verses.textEnNasb: Wash yourself therefore, and anoint yourself, and put on your best clothes, and go down to the threshing floor; but do not reveal yourself to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
verses.textEn: Wash, put on perfume, and get dressed in your best clothes. Then go down to the threshing floor, but don’t let him know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.

verses.textZh: 等到他躺下来，你要弄清楚他所躺的地方，进去掀露他的脚，然后躺下去。他就会告诉你该作甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到他躺下来，你要弄清楚他所躺的地方，进去掀露他的脚，然后躺下去。他就会告诉你该作甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到他睡的时候，你看准他睡的地方，就进去掀开他脚上的被，躺卧在那里，他必告诉你所当做的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he lies down, note the place where he is lying. Then go and uncover his feet and lie down. He will tell you what to do."
verses.textEnEsv: But when he lies down, observe the place where he lies. Then go and uncover his feet and lie down, and he will tell you what to do."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be, when he lies down, that you shall notice the place where he lies; and you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down; and he will tell you what you should do."
verses.textEnNlt: Be sure to notice where he lies down; then go and uncover his feet and lie down there. He will tell you what to do."
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be when he lies down, that you shall take notice of the place where he lies, and you shall go and uncover his feet and lie down; then he will tell you what you should do."
verses.textEn: When he lies down, note the place where he is lying. Then go and uncover his feet and lie down. He will tell you what to do."

verses.textZh: 路得对她说："你吩咐的，我就去作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 路得对她说："你吩咐的，我就去作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 路得说：「凡你所吩咐的，我必遵行。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I will do whatever you say," Ruth answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And she replied, "All that you say I will do."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said to her, "All that you say to me I will do."
verses.textEnNlt: "I will do everything you say," Ruth replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And she said to her, "All that you say I will do."
verses.textEn: "I will do whatever you say," Ruth answered.

verses.textZh: 于是，她下到禾场去，照着婆婆吩咐的一切去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，她下到禾场去，照着婆婆吩咐的一切去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 路得就下到场上，照她婆婆所吩咐她的而行。
verses.textEnNiv: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law told her to do.
verses.textEnEsv: So she went down to the threshing floor and did just as her mother-in-law had commanded her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she went down to the threshing floor and did according to all that her mother-in-law instructed her.
verses.textEnNlt: So she went down to the threshing floor that night and followed the instructions of her mother-in-law.
verses.textEnNasb: So she went down to the threshing floor and did according to all that her mother-in-law had commanded her.
verses.textEn: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law told her to do.

verses.textZh: 波阿斯吃喝完了，心里舒畅，就去躺在麦堆的旁边。路得悄悄地来，掀露他的脚，躺卧下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯吃喝完了，心里舒畅，就去躺在麦堆的旁边。路得悄悄地来，掀露他的脚，躺卧下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯吃喝完了，心里欢畅，就去睡在麦堆旁边。路得便悄悄地来掀开他脚上的被，躺卧在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went over to lie down at the far end of the grain pile. Ruth approached quietly, uncovered his feet and lay down.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. Then she came softly and uncovered his feet and lay down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was cheerful, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain; and she came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.
verses.textEnNlt: After Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he lay down at the far end of the pile of grain and went to sleep. Then Ruth came quietly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.
verses.textEnNasb: When Boaz had eaten and drunk and his heart was cheerful, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain; and she came secretly, and uncovered his feet and lay down.
verses.textEn: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went over to lie down at the far end of the grain pile. Ruth approached quietly, uncovered his feet and lay down.

verses.textZh: 到了夜半，波阿斯惊醒过来，一翻身就看到一个女子躺在他的脚边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了夜半，波阿斯惊醒过来，一翻身就看到一个女子躺在他的脚边，
verses.textZhCuv: 到了夜半，那人忽然惊醒，翻过身来，不料有女子躺在他的脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: In the middle of the night something startled the man; he turned—and there was a woman lying at his feet!
verses.textEnEsv: At midnight the man was startled and turned over, and behold, a woman lay at his feet!
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened at midnight that the man was startled, and turned himself; and there, a woman was lying at his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: Around midnight Boaz suddenly woke up and turned over. He was surprised to find a woman lying at his feet!
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened in the middle of the night that the man was startled and bent forward; and behold, a woman was lying at his feet.
verses.textEn: In the middle of the night something startled the man; he turned—and there was a woman lying at his feet!

verses.textZh: 就说："你是谁？"她回答："我是你的婢女路得，请用你的衣襟遮盖你的婢女，因为你是我一个有买赎权的近亲。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就说："你是谁？"她回答："我是你的婢女路得，请用你的衣襟遮盖你的婢女，因为你是我一个有买赎权的近亲。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就说：「你是谁？」回答说：「我是你的婢女路得。求你用你的衣襟遮盖我，因为你是我一个至近的亲属。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Who are you?" he asked. "I am your servant Ruth," she said. "Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a guardian-redeemer of our family."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Who are you?" And she answered, "I am Ruth, your servant. Spread your wings over your servant, for you are a redeemer."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Who are you?" So she answered, "I am Ruth, your maidservant. Take your maidservant under your wing, for you are a close relative."
verses.textEnNlt: "Who are you?" he asked. "I am your servant Ruth," she replied. "Spread the corner of your covering over me, for you are my family redeemer."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "Who are you?" And she answered, "I am Ruth your slave. Now spread your garment over your slave, for you are a redeemer."
verses.textEn: "Who are you?" he asked. "I am your servant Ruth," she said. "Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a guardian-redeemer of our family."

verses.textZh: 波阿斯说："我女儿，愿你蒙耶和华赐福。你末后表现的爱心比起初更大，因为年轻人无论贫富，你都没有跟从。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯说："我女儿，愿你蒙耶和华赐福。你末后表现的爱心比起初更大，因为年轻人无论贫富，你都没有跟从。
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯说：「女儿啊，愿你蒙耶和华赐福。你末后的恩比先前更大；因为少年人无论贫富，你都没有跟从。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord bless you, my daughter," he replied. "This kindness is greater than that which you showed earlier: You have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "May you be blessed by the Lord , my daughter. You have made this last kindness greater than the first in that you have not gone after young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Blessed are you of the Lord, my daughter! For you have shown more kindness at the end than at the beginning, in that you did not go after young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord bless you, my daughter!" Boaz exclaimed. "You are showing even more family loyalty now than you did before, for you have not gone after a younger man, whether rich or poor.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "May you be blessed of the Lord, my daughter. You have shown your last kindness to be better than the first, by not going after young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.textEn: "The Lord bless you, my daughter," he replied. "This kindness is greater than that which you showed earlier: You have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.

verses.textZh: 我女儿，现在你不要怕，你所说的，我一定去作。本城的人都知道你是个贤慧的女人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我女儿，现在你不要怕，你所说的，我一定去作。本城的人都知道你是个贤慧的女人。
verses.textZhCuv: 女儿啊，现在不要惧怕，凡你所说的，我必照着行；我本城的人都知道你是个贤德的女子。
verses.textEnNiv: And now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do for you all you ask. All the people of my town know that you are a woman of noble character.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, my daughter, do not fear. I will do for you all that you ask, for all my fellow townsmen know that you are a worthy woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, my daughter, do not fear. I will do for you all that you request, for all the people of my town know that you are a virtuous woman.
verses.textEnNlt: Now don’t worry about a thing, my daughter. I will do what is necessary, for everyone in town knows you are a virtuous woman.
verses.textEnNasb: So now, my daughter, do not fear. I will do for you whatever you say, for all my people in the city know that you are a woman of excellence.
verses.textEn: And now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do for you all you ask. All the people of my town know that you are a woman of noble character.

verses.textZh: 不错，我是你那有买赎权的近亲，可惜还有一个有买赎权的近亲比我更亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不错，我是你那有买赎权的近亲，可惜还有一个有买赎权的近亲比我更亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 我实在是你一个至近的亲属，只是还有一个人比我更近。
verses.textEnNiv: Although it is true that I am a guardian-redeemer of our family, there is another who is more closely related than I.
verses.textEnEsv: And now it is true that I am a redeemer. Yet there is a redeemer nearer than I.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it is true that I am a close relative; however, there is a relative closer than I.
verses.textEnNlt: But while it’s true that I am one of your family redeemers, there is another man who is more closely related to you than I am.
verses.textEnNasb: But now, although it is true that I am a redeemer, yet there is also a redeemer more closely related than I.
verses.textEn: Although it is true that I am a guardian-redeemer of our family, there is another who is more closely related than I.

verses.textZh: 今晚你就在这里过夜，明早如果他肯尽买赎你的本分，好，就由他来履行；假如他不愿意这样作，我指着永活的耶和华起誓，我一定尽买赎你的本分。你只管躺到天亮吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 今晚你就在这里过夜，明早如果他肯尽买赎你的本分，好，就由他来履行；假如他不愿意这样作，我指着永活的耶和华起誓，我一定尽买赎你的本分。你只管躺到天亮吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你今夜在这里住宿，明早他若肯为你尽亲属的本分，就由他吧！倘若不肯，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我必为你尽了本分，你只管躺到天亮。」
verses.textEnNiv: Stay here for the night, and in the morning if he wants to do his duty as your guardian-redeemer, good; let him redeem you. But if he is not willing, as surely as the Lord lives I will do it. Lie here until morning."
verses.textEnEsv: Remain tonight, and in the morning, if he will redeem you, good; let him do it. But if he is not willing to redeem you, then, as the Lord lives, I will redeem you. Lie down until the morning."
verses.textEnNkjv: Stay this night, and in the morning it shall be that if he will perform the duty of a close relative for you—good; let him do it. But if he does not want to perform the duty for you, then I will perform the duty for you, as the Lord lives! Lie down until morning."
verses.textEnNlt: Stay here tonight, and in the morning I will talk to him. If he is willing to redeem you, very well. Let him marry you. But if he is not willing, then as surely as the Lord lives, I will redeem you myself! Now lie down here until morning."
verses.textEnNasb: Remain this night, and when morning comes, if he will redeem you, good; let him redeem you. But if he does not wish to redeem you, then I will redeem you, as the Lord lives. Lie down until morning."
verses.textEn: Stay here for the night, and in the morning if he wants to do his duty as your guardian-redeemer, good; let him redeem you. But if he is not willing, as surely as the Lord lives I will do it. Lie here until morning."

verses.textZh: 路得躺在波阿斯脚边直到早晨。因为波阿斯说过不可以让人知道有女人来过禾场，路得就趁天色未明，人们彼此无法辨认的时候就起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 路得躺在波阿斯脚边直到早晨。因为波阿斯说过不可以让人知道有女人来过禾场，路得就趁天色未明，人们彼此无法辨认的时候就起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 路得便在他脚下躺到天快亮，人彼此不能辨认的时候就起来了。波阿斯说：「不可使人知道有女子到场上来」；
verses.textEnNiv: So she lay at his feet until morning, but got up before anyone could be recognized; and he said, "No one must know that a woman came to the threshing floor."
verses.textEnEsv: So she lay at his feet until the morning, but arose before one could recognize another. And he said, "Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor."
verses.textEnNkjv: So she lay at his feet until morning, and she arose before one could recognize another. Then he said, "Do not let it be known that the woman came to the threshing floor."
verses.textEnNlt: So Ruth lay at Boaz’s feet until the morning, but she got up before it was light enough for people to recognize each other. For Boaz had said, "No one must know that a woman was here at the threshing floor."
verses.textEnNasb: So she lay at his feet until morning, and got up before one person could recognize another; and he said, "Do not let it be known that the woman came to the threshing floor."
verses.textEn: So she lay at his feet until morning, but got up before anyone could be recognized; and he said, "No one must know that a woman came to the threshing floor."

verses.textZh: 他又说："拿你所披的外衣来，把它打开。"她打开了，他就量了六簸箕大麦，放在她的肩上。路得就进城去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又说："拿你所披的外衣来，把它打开。"她打开了，他就量了六簸箕大麦，放在她的肩上。路得就进城去。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对路得说：「打开你所披的外衣。」她打开了，波阿斯就撮了六簸箕大麦，帮她扛在肩上，她便进城去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He also said, "Bring me the shawl you are wearing and hold it out." When she did so, he poured into it six measures of barley and placed the bundle on her. Then he went back to town.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Bring the garment you are wearing and hold it out." So she held it, and he measured out six measures of barley and put it on her. Then she went into the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he said, "Bring the shawl that is on you and hold it." And when she held it, he measured six ephahs of barley, and laid it on her. Then she went into the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Boaz said to her, "Bring your cloak and spread it out." He measured six scoops of barley into the cloak and placed it on her back. Then he returned to the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Again he said, "Give me the shawl that is on you and hold it." So she held it, and he measured six measures of barley and laid it on her. Then she went into the city.
verses.textEn: He also said, "Bring me the shawl you are wearing and hold it out." When she did so, he poured into it six measures of barley and placed the bundle on her. Then he went back to town.

verses.textZh: 到她婆婆那里，婆婆就问："我女儿，怎样了？"路得就把那人对她所作的一切都告诉了婆婆，
verses.textZhCnvs: 到她婆婆那里，婆婆就问："我女儿，怎样了？"路得就把那人对她所作的一切都告诉了婆婆，
verses.textZhCuv: 路得回到婆婆那里，婆婆说：「女儿啊，怎么样了？」路得就将那人向她所行的述说了一遍，
verses.textEnNiv: When Ruth came to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked, "How did it go, my daughter?" Then she told her everything Boaz had done for her
verses.textEnEsv: And when she came to her mother-in-law, she said, "How did you fare, my daughter?" Then she told her all that the man had done for her,
verses.textEnNkjv: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, "Is that you, my daughter?" Then she told her all that the man had done for her.
verses.textEnNlt: When Ruth went back to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked, "What happened, my daughter?" Ruth told Naomi everything Boaz had done for her,
verses.textEnNasb: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, " How did it go, my daughter?" And she told her all that the man had done for her.
verses.textEn: When Ruth came to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked, "How did it go, my daughter?" Then she told her everything Boaz had done for her

verses.textZh: 又说："他给我这六簸箕大麦，对我说：‘不要空手去见你婆婆。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："他给我这六簸箕大麦，对我说：‘不要空手去见你婆婆。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「那人给了我六簸箕大麦，对我说：『你不可空手回去见你的婆婆。』」
verses.textEnNiv: and added, "He gave me these six measures of barley, saying, ‘Don’t go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "These six measures of barley he gave to me, for he said to me, ‘You must not go back empty-handed to your mother-in-law.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said, "These six ephahs of barley he gave me; for he said to me, ‘Do not go empty-handed to your mother-in-law.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: and she added, "He gave me these six scoops of barley and said, ‘Don’t go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’"
verses.textEnNasb: She also said, "These six measures of barley he gave to me, for he said, ‘Do not go to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’ "
verses.textEn: and added, "He gave me these six measures of barley, saying, ‘Don’t go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’ "

verses.textZh: 拿俄米说："我女儿，你尽管安静等候，直到你知道事情怎样了结，因为那人今天不把事情办妥，绝不歇息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米说："我女儿，你尽管安静等候，直到你知道事情怎样了结，因为那人今天不把事情办妥，绝不歇息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 婆婆说：「女儿啊，你只管安坐等候，看这事怎样成就，因为那人今日不办成这事必不休息。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Naomi said, "Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today."
verses.textEnEsv: She replied, "Wait, my daughter, until you learn how the matter turns out, for the man will not rest but will settle the matter today."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said, "Sit still, my daughter, until you know how the matter will turn out; for the man will not rest until he has concluded the matter this day."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Naomi said to her, "Just be patient, my daughter, until we hear what happens. The man won’t rest until he has settled things today."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said, "Wait, my daughter, until you know how the matter turns out; for the man will not rest until he has settled it today."
verses.textEn: Then Naomi said, "Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today."

verses.textZh: 波阿斯到了城门，坐在那里，波阿斯所说那个有买赎权的近亲刚巧路过那里。波阿斯说："喂，老兄，过来坐一下吧。"他就过去坐下来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯到了城门，坐在那里，波阿斯所说那个有买赎权的近亲刚巧路过那里。波阿斯说："喂，老兄，过来坐一下吧。"他就过去坐下来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯到了城门，坐在那里，恰巧波阿斯所说的那至近的亲属经过。波阿斯说：「某人哪，你来坐在这里。」他就来坐下。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there just as the guardian-redeemer he had mentioned came along. Boaz said, "Come over here, my friend, and sit down." So he went over and sat down.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Boaz had gone up to the gate and sat down there. And behold, the redeemer, of whom Boaz had spoken, came by. So Boaz said, "Turn aside, friend; sit down here." And he turned aside and sat down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there; and behold, the close relative of whom Boaz had spoken came by. So Boaz said, "Come aside, friend, sit down here." So he came aside and sat down.
verses.textEnNlt: Boaz went to the town gate and took a seat there. Just then the family redeemer he had mentioned came by, so Boaz called out to him, "Come over here and sit down, friend. I want to talk to you." So they sat down together.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there, and behold, the redeemer of whom Boaz spoke was passing by, so he said, "Come over here, friend, sit down here." And he came over and sat down.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile Boaz went up to the town gate and sat down there just as the guardian-redeemer he had mentioned came along. Boaz said, "Come over here, my friend, and sit down." So he went over and sat down.

verses.textZh: 波阿斯又邀请城里的十个长老，对他们说："请坐在这里。"他们就坐下来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯又邀请城里的十个长老，对他们说："请坐在这里。"他们就坐下来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯又从本城的长老中拣选了十人，对他们说：「请你们坐在这里。」他们就都坐下。
verses.textEnNiv: Boaz took ten of the elders of the town and said, "Sit here," and they did so.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took ten men of the elders of the city and said, "Sit down here." So they sat down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, "Sit down here." So they sat down.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Boaz called ten leaders from the town and asked them to sit as witnesses.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took ten men of the elders of the city and said, "Sit down here." So they sat down.
verses.textEn: Boaz took ten of the elders of the town and said, "Sit here," and they did so.

verses.textZh: 他对那那个有买赎权的近亲说："从摩押地回来的拿俄米，现在要卖我们族兄以利米勒的那块地；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对那那个有买赎权的近亲说："从摩押地回来的拿俄米，现在要卖我们族兄以利米勒的那块地；
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯对那至近的亲属说：「从摩押地回来的拿俄米，现在要卖我们族兄以利米勒的那块地；
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to the guardian-redeemer, "Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to the redeemer, "Naomi, who has come back from the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land that belonged to our relative Elimelech.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to the close relative, "Naomi, who has come back from the country of Moab, sold the piece of land which belonged to our brother Elimelech.
verses.textEnNlt: And Boaz said to the family redeemer, "You know Naomi, who came back from Moab. She is selling the land that belonged to our relative Elimelech.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to the redeemer, "Naomi, who has returned from the land of Moab, has to sell the plot of land which belonged to our brother Elimelech.
verses.textEn: Then he said to the guardian-redeemer, "Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our relative Elimelek.

verses.textZh: 我想把这一件事告诉你，请你众民的长老，还有在座的各位面前，把它买下来吧。如果你肯赎就赎，假如不肯，就说出来，让我知道；因为除了你当赎它之外，我是第一候补。"那人说："我肯赎。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我想把这一件事告诉你，请你众民的长老，还有在座的各位面前，把它买下来吧。如果你肯赎就赎，假如不肯，就说出来，让我知道；因为除了你当赎它之外，我是第一候补。"那人说："我肯赎。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我想当赎那块地的是你，其次是我，以外再没有别人了。你可以在这里的人面前和我本国的长老面前说明，你若肯赎就赎，若不肯赎就告诉我。」那人回答说：「我肯赎。」
verses.textEnNiv: I thought I should bring the matter to your attention and suggest that you buy it in the presence of these seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so. But if you will not, tell me, so I will know. For no one has the right to do it except you, and I am next in line." "I will redeem it," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: So I thought I would tell you of it and say, ‘Buy it in the presence of those sitting here and in the presence of the elders of my people.’ If you will redeem it, redeem it. But if you will not, tell me, that I may know, for there is no one besides you to redeem it, and I come after you." And he said, "I will redeem it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I thought to inform you, saying, ‘Buy it back in the presence of the inhabitants and the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know; for thereis no one but you to redeem it, and I am next after you.’ " And he said, "I will redeem it."
verses.textEnNlt: I thought I should speak to you about it so that you can redeem it if you wish. If you want the land, then buy it here in the presence of these witnesses.
