But if you don’t want it, let me know right away, because I am next in line to redeem it after you." The man replied, "All right, I’ll redeem it."
verses.textEnNasb: So I thought that I would inform you, saying, ‘Buy it before those who are sitting here, and before the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if not, tell me so that I may know; for there is no one except you to redeem it, and I am after you.’ " And he said, "I will redeem it."
verses.textEn: I thought I should bring the matter to your attention and suggest that you buy it in the presence of these seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so. But if you will not, tell me, so I will know. For no one has the right to do it except you, and I am next in line." "I will redeem it," he said.

verses.textZh: 波阿斯说："你从拿俄米手中买下那块地的时候，你也得娶 已死的人的妻子摩押女子路得，使已死的人的名字留在他的产业上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯说："你从拿俄米手中买下那块地的时候，你也得娶 已死的人的妻子摩押女子路得，使已死的人的名字留在他的产业上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯说：「你从拿俄米手中买这地的时候，也当娶 死人的妻摩押女子路得，使死人在产业上存留他的名。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Boaz said, "On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the dead man’s widow, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Boaz said, "The day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the widow of the dead, in order to perpetuate the name of the dead in his inheritance."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Boaz said, "On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must also buy it from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to perpetuate the name of the dead through his inheritance."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Boaz told him, "Of course, your purchase of the land from Naomi also requires that you marry Ruth, the Moabite widow. That way she can have children who will carry on her husband’s name and keep the land in the family."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Boaz said, "On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must also acquire Ruth the Moabitess, the widow of the deceased, in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance."
verses.textEn: Then Boaz said, "On the day you buy the land from Naomi, you also acquire Ruth the Moabite, the dead man’s widow, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property."

verses.textZh: 那有买赎权的近亲说："那我就不能赎它了，只怕损害了我的产业。你可以赎我当赎的，因为我没有办法赎了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那有买赎权的近亲说："那我就不能赎它了，只怕损害了我的产业。你可以赎我当赎的，因为我没有办法赎了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说：「这样我就不能赎了，恐怕于我的产业有碍。你可以赎我所当赎的，我不能赎了。」
verses.textEnNiv: At this, the guardian-redeemer said, "Then I cannot redeem it because I might endanger my own estate. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the redeemer said, "I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I impair my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption yourself, for I cannot redeem it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the close relative said, "I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I ruin my own inheritance. You redeem my right of redemption for yourself, for I cannot redeem it."
verses.textEnNlt: "Then I can’t redeem it," the family redeemer replied, "because this might endanger my own estate. You redeem the land; I cannot do it."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the redeemer said, "I cannot redeem it for myself, otherwise I would jeopardize my own inheritance. Redeem it for yourself; you may have my right of redemption, since I cannot redeem it."
verses.textEn: At this, the guardian-redeemer said, "Then I cannot redeem it because I might endanger my own estate. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it."

verses.textZh: 从前在以色列，无论买赎或是交易，决定甚么事，当事人就要脱鞋给对方。这是以色列中作证的方式。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前在以色列，无论买赎或是交易，决定甚么事，当事人就要脱鞋给对方。这是以色列中作证的方式。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前，在以色列中要定夺什么事，或赎回，或交易，这人就脱鞋给那人。以色列人都以此为证据。
verses.textEnNiv: (Now in earlier times in Israel, for the redemption and transfer of property to become final, one party took off his sandal and gave it to the other. This was the method of legalizing transactions in Israel.)
verses.textEnEsv: Now this was the custom in former times in Israel concerning redeeming and exchanging: to confirm a transaction, the one drew off his sandal and gave it to the other, and this was the manner of attesting in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this wasthecustom in former times in Israel concerning redeeming and exchanging, to confirm anything: one man took off his sandal and gave it to the other, and this was a confirmation in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Now in those days it was the custom in Israel for anyone transferring a right of purchase to remove his sandal and hand it to the other party. This publicly validated the transaction.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this was the custom in former times in Israel concerning the redemption and the exchange of land to confirm any matter: a man removed his sandal and gave it to another; and this was the way of confirmation in Israel.
verses.textEn: (Now in earlier times in Israel, for the redemption and transfer of property to become final, one party took off his sandal and gave it to the other. This was the method of legalizing transactions in Israel.)

verses.textZh: 那有买赎权的近亲对波阿斯说："你自己买下来吧。"就把鞋脱下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那有买赎权的近亲对波阿斯说："你自己买下来吧。"就把鞋脱下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人对波阿斯说：「你自己买吧！」于是将鞋脱下来了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the guardian-redeemer said to Boaz, "Buy it yourself." And he removed his sandal.
verses.textEnEsv: So when the redeemer said to Boaz, "Buy it for yourself," he drew off his sandal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the close relative said to Boaz, "Buy it for yourself." So he took off his sandal.
verses.textEnNlt: So the other family redeemer drew off his sandal as he said to Boaz, "You buy the land."
verses.textEnNasb: So the redeemer said to Boaz, "Buy it for yourself." And he removed his sandal.
verses.textEn: So the guardian-redeemer said to Boaz, "Buy it yourself." And he removed his sandal.

verses.textZh: 波阿斯对长老和众人说："今天你们都是见证人，所有属于以利米勒、基连和玛伦的，我都从拿俄米手中买下来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波阿斯对长老和众人说："今天你们都是见证人，所有属于以利米勒、基连和玛伦的，我都从拿俄米手中买下来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 波阿斯对长老和众民说：「你们今日作见证，凡属以利米勒和基连、玛伦的，我都从拿俄米手中置买了；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, "Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelek, Kilion and Mahlon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Boaz said to the elders and all the people, "You are witnesses this day that I have bought from the hand of Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech and all that belonged to Chilion and to Mahlon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Boaz said to the elders and all the people, "You are witnesses this day that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Boaz said to the elders and to the crowd standing around, "You are witnesses that today I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelech, Kilion, and Mahlon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Boaz said to the elders and all the people, "You are witnesses today that I have bought from the hand of Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech and all that belonged to Chilion and Mahlon.
verses.textEn: Then Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, "Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelek, Kilion and Mahlon.

verses.textZh: 我也娶了 玛伦的妻子摩押女子路得作妻子，使已死的人的名字留在他的产业上，免得他的名字在本族本乡中除掉。今天你们都是见证人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也娶了 玛伦的妻子摩押女子路得作妻子，使已死的人的名字留在他的产业上，免得他的名字在本族本乡中除掉。今天你们都是见证人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又娶了玛伦的妻摩押女子路得为妻，好在死人的产业上存留他的名，免得他的名在本族本乡灭没。你们今日可以作见证。」
verses.textEnNiv: I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property, so that his name will not disappear from among his family or from his hometown. Today you are witnesses!"
verses.textEnEsv: Also Ruth the Moabite, the widow of Mahlon, I have bought to be my wife, to perpetuate the name of the dead in his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his native place. You are witnesses this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the widow of Mahlon, I have acquired as my wife, to perpetuate the name of the dead through his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brethren and from his position at the gate. You are witnesses this day."
verses.textEnNlt: And with the land I have acquired Ruth, the Moabite widow of Mahlon, to be my wife. This way she can have a son to carry on the family name of her dead husband and to inherit the family property here in his hometown. You are all witnesses today."
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, I have acquired Ruth the Moabitess, the widow of Mahlon, to be my wife in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance, so that the name of the deceased will not be eliminated from his brothers or from the court of his birth place; you are witnesses today."
verses.textEn: I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property, so that his name will not disappear from among his family or from his hometown. Today you are witnesses!"

verses.textZh: 聚集在城门的众人和长老都说："我们都是见证人。愿耶和华使进你家的这女人，像建立以色列家的拉结和利亚二人一样。愿你在以法他显大，在伯利恒扬名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 聚集在城门的众人和长老都说："我们都是见证人。愿耶和华使进你家的这女人，像建立以色列家的拉结和利亚二人一样。愿你在以法他显大，在伯利恒扬名。
verses.textZhCuv: 在城门坐着的众民和长老都说：「我们作见证。愿耶和华使进你家的这女子，像建立以色列家的拉结、利亚二人一样。又愿你在以法他得亨通，在伯利恒得名声。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the elders and all the people at the gate said, "We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the family of Israel. May you have standing in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people who were at the gate and the elders said, "We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman, who is coming into your house, like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel. May you act worthily in Ephrathah and be renowned in Bethlehem,
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people who were at the gate, and the elders, said, "Weare witnesses. The Lord make the woman who is coming to your house like Rachel and Leah, the two who built the house of Israel; and may you prosper in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the elders and all the people standing in the gate replied, "We are witnesses! May the Lord make this woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, from whom all the nation of Israel descended! May you prosper in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people who were in the court, and the elders, said, "We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, both of whom built the house of Israel; and may you achieve wealth in Ephrathah and become famous in Bethlehem.
verses.textEn: Then the elders and all the people at the gate said, "We are witnesses. May the Lord make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the family of Israel. May you have standing in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华从这少妇赐你后裔，使你的家像他玛从犹大所生法勒斯的家一般。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华从这少妇赐你后裔，使你的家像他玛从犹大所生法勒斯的家一般。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华从这少年女子赐你后裔，使你的家像她玛从犹大所生法勒斯的家一般。」
verses.textEnNiv: Through the offspring the Lord gives you by this young woman, may your family be like that of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah."
verses.textEnEsv: and may your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring that the Lord will give you by this young woman."
verses.textEnNkjv: May your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring which the Lord will give you from this young woman."
verses.textEnNlt: And may the Lord give you descendants by this young woman who will be like those of our ancestor Perez, the son of Tamar and Judah."
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, may your house be like the house of Perez whom Tamar bore to Judah, through the descendants whom the Lord will give you by this young woman."
verses.textEn: Through the offspring the Lord gives you by this young woman, may your family be like that of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah."

verses.textZh: 于是波阿斯娶了路得作妻子，与她亲近。耶和华使她怀孕生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是波阿斯娶了路得作妻子，与她亲近。耶和华使她怀孕生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，波阿斯娶了路得为妻，与她同房。耶和华使她怀孕生了一个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. When he made love to her, the Lord enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
verses.textEnEsv: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. And he went in to her, and the Lord gave her conception, and she bore a son.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and when he went in to her, the Lord gave her conception, and she bore a son.
verses.textEnNlt: So Boaz took Ruth into his home, and she became his wife. When he slept with her, the Lord enabled her to become pregnant, and she gave birth to a son.
verses.textEnNasb: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife, and he had relations with her. And the Lord enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
verses.textEn: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. When he made love to her, the Lord enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.

verses.textZh: 妇女对拿俄米说："耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他今天没有断绝你有买赎权的近亲，愿他在以色列中扬名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇女对拿俄米说："耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他今天没有断绝你有买赎权的近亲，愿他在以色列中扬名。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人们对拿俄米说：「耶和华是应当称颂的！因为今日没有撇下你，使你无至近的亲属。愿这孩子在以色列中得名声。
verses.textEnNiv: The women said to Naomi: "Praise be to the Lord , who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer. May he become famous throughout Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: Then the women said to Naomi, "Blessed be the Lord , who has not left you this day without a redeemer, and may his name be renowned in Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the women said to Naomi, "Blessed be the Lord, who has not left you this day without a close relative; and may his name be famous in Israel!
verses.textEnNlt: Then the women of the town said to Naomi, "Praise the Lord , who has now provided a redeemer for your family! May this child be famous in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the women said to Naomi, "Blessed is the Lord who has not left you without a redeemer today, and may his name become famous in Israel.
verses.textEn: The women said to Naomi: "Praise be to the Lord , who this day has not left you without a guardian-redeemer. May he become famous throughout Israel!

verses.textZh: 他必苏醒你的生命，养你的老，因为他是爱你的媳妇所生的；有她比有七个儿子更好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必苏醒你的生命，养你的老，因为他是爱你的媳妇所生的；有她比有七个儿子更好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他必提起你的精神，奉养你的老，因为是爱慕你的那儿妇所生的。有这儿妇比有七个儿子还好！」
verses.textEnNiv: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth."
verses.textEnEsv: He shall be to you a restorer of life and a nourisher of your old age, for your daughter-in-law who loves you, who is more to you than seven sons, has given birth to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And may he be to you a restorer of life and a nourisher of your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has borne him."
verses.textEnNlt: May he restore your youth and care for you in your old age. For he is the son of your daughter-in-law who loves you and has been better to you than seven sons!"
verses.textEnNasb: May he also be to you one who restores life and sustains your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him."
verses.textEn: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth."

verses.textZh: 拿俄米把孩子接过来，抱在怀中，作他的保姆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿俄米把孩子接过来，抱在怀中，作他的保姆。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿俄米就把孩子抱在怀中，作他的养母。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Naomi took the child in her arms and cared for him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Naomi took the child and laid him on her lap and became his nurse.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Naomi took the child and laid him on her bosom, and became a nurse to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Naomi took the baby and cuddled him to her breast. And she cared for him as if he were her own.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Naomi took the child and laid him in her lap, and became his nurse.
verses.textEn: Then Naomi took the child in her arms and cared for him.

verses.textZh: 邻近的妇女要给他起名字，说："拿俄米生了孩子了。"就给他起名叫俄备得；这俄备得是耶西的父亲，耶西是大卫的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 邻近的妇女要给他起名字，说："拿俄米生了孩子了。"就给他起名叫俄备得；这俄备得是耶西的父亲，耶西是大卫的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 邻舍的妇人说：「拿俄米得孩子了！」就给孩子起名叫俄备得。这俄备得是耶西的父，耶西是大卫的父。
verses.textEnNiv: The women living there said, "Naomi has a son!" And they named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And the women of the neighborhood gave him a name, saying, "A son has been born to Naomi." They named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the neighbor women gave him a name, saying, "There is a son born to Naomi." And they called his name Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.textEnNlt: The neighbor women said, "Now at last Naomi has a son again!" And they named him Obed. He became the father of Jesse and the grandfather of David.
verses.textEnNasb: And the neighbor women gave him a name, saying, "A son has been born to Naomi!" So they named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.textEn: The women living there said, "Naomi has a son!" And they named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.

verses.textZh: 以下是法勒斯的后代：法勒斯生希斯仑，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是法勒斯的后代：法勒斯生希斯仑，
verses.textZhCuv: 法勒斯的后代记在下面：法勒斯生希斯仑；
verses.textEnNiv: This, then, is the family line of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron,
verses.textEnEsv: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez fathered Hezron,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this is the genealogy of Perez: Perez begot Hezron;
verses.textEnNlt: This is the genealogical record of their ancestor Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez fathered Hezron,
verses.textEn: This, then, is the family line of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron,

verses.textEn: Hezron the father of Ram, Ram the father of Amminadab,
